controlled_change: New developer-only diagnostic allowance of 512MiB compressed lifetime peak; old clean qualification remains unchanged. One traced reference process uses the same native build, mixed artifact, prepared experts, 1072 slots, 12GiB budget and seventeen outputs in each phase.
correctness: 354 Python tests pass. Offline and independent audits verify frozen identity, exact prior reference outputs, reuse, 101600 dispatches, 1536 layer passes, 15360 expert records, 76 memory observations and all 32 interval sweeps. Full-state evidence is reused from the compatible sealed proof.
decision_origin: authored interpretation; original report statuses retained
expected_effect: Complete 32 decode forwards and rank exclusive waiting/GPU costs, with per-token compression/decompression rather than stopping data collection at the first nonzero value.
hypothesis: A separately bounded reference diagnostic can expose the actual decode GPU/read dependencies while retaining limited observed compression as a confounder.
limitations: One instrumented reference produces hypotheses, not a causal bottleneck or speedup claim.
Compression and host conditions confound timing; all tokens remain included and no timing correction is applied.
Command classes, read service and CPU intervals overlap the exclusive timeline and are not additional removable time.
512MiB is an operational completed-run acceptance bound, not a live cancellation threshold or an empirical harmlessness threshold.
Previous blocked reports, negative candidates and qualification gates remain unchanged.
outcome: Diagnostic completed in 51.836 seconds within declared bounds. GPU execution was 126.51/145.44ms per token; pending-read idle 58.37/61.83ms; total traced forwards 274.06/297.74ms. Physical peak 8.604GiB, compressed peak 108.75MiB, unchanged swap. Append was slower with only two in-forward decompressions versus 354 initially. Strict clean-memory classification remains false; no performance comparison or promotion.
smallest_experiment: Test exact decode-only fusion of layer hyper up-projection, sigmoid and four-stream mix in four complete real blocks, retaining unchanged injection work. The theoretical reduction is 192 dispatches per token, not the whole 54-62ms mixed class. Five short alternating pairs and a material whole-block gain gate precede any native integration; details in next-experiment.md.
